$comment: The cardiac-arrest instrument's facility service. Vocabulary rule (SPEC 2b): this instrument is READINESS -- الجاهزية -- and never التأهب. Status labels (Current/Lapsing/Lapsed, the standing lines) are PROVISIONAL: the policy prescribes no status vocabulary and final labels await Ministry approval (policy 10, SPEC status note); provisionalNote renders on the Ministry cardiac configuration screen, the label-owner side, not on the operator record (partner ruling, second sweep). Mass-gathering outcome vocabulary never appears here.

confirmation.en: I confirm the referenced arrangements will remain accessible and operational throughout the event.

footprint.en: Coverage of the temporary spectator area
footprint.bodyEn: The referenced devices cover the permanent building. The temporary area added for this event is not covered by them and needs its own arrangement.
footprint.bodyAr: تغطي الأجهزة المُحال إليها المبنى الدائم. أما المنطقة المؤقتة المضافة لهذه الفعالية فغير مشمولة بها وتحتاج ترتيباً خاصاً بها.
